pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I... I'VE BEEN LISTENING TO YOU FOR YEARS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT’S ALL I EVER GET OUT OF YOU.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT I NEVER KNOW WHAT IT MEANS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NOT WHEN HE SAID IT EITHER

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND YOU SAY IT AND YOU MIGHT AS WELL BE DEAD.
